text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At night, in the student dorms.
Curren Chan was troubled, all by herself.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...I should be fine posting this photo, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Adjust the exposure and contrast,
use a warm-toned filter, and finish with a skin-smoothing effect."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "...I've been using the same editing filter way too much lately. I need to get my skin back into good shape soon."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan was secretly troubled
by skincare concerns...
